execution_pr_policy: one PR on or after earliest_safe_action_at

capture.contract: persisted CONFENGE_WEB lead capture introduced by issue #289

preconditions_all_required.evidence: current date is on or after 2026-09-16
PR #307 merged the derived priced_offer persisted-capture profile and its fail-closed tests

execution_sequence: Rebase the execution branch on the then-current origin/main.
Re-run the comparable measurement gate and abort unless it is ready.
Mark every evidenced precondition READY and set html_mutation_authorized=true only in the reviewed execution PR; the date or evidential close alone is insufficient.
Remove the three before-equals-after entries with a written no-op reason.
Apply only the three true replacements through the frozen patch mechanism.
Add persisted capture to all six pillars without changing the source or attribution contract.
Add FAQPage and Person only to diagnostico-b2g-360 with visible parity.
Run the non-hash content and contract checks, then inspect the expected frozen drift before recapture.
Recapture hashes and snapshots without --force, then run every required gate against the reviewed baseline.
rollback: Restore its pre-execution hashes.json and snapshots.json in the same revert.
Verify the six canonical URLs and frozen protected paths; never change earliest_safe_action_at to make rollback pass.
non_claims: this plan does not authorize HTML mutation
the date alone does not prove core readiness
a green prepare-only PR is not an index or pipeline outcome
